div.div: مِفْأَدٌ (T, S, M, L, K) and ↓ مِفْأَدَةٌ (S, L, K) and ↓ مِفْآدٌ (T, M, L, K) The [iron instrument, with which flesh-meat is roasted, called] سَفُّود, (T, S, M, L, K,) [or] with which one roasts and bakes. (L, TA.) And [in the CK “ or ”] the first, (S, L, K,) and the second and third also, (accord. to the K,) the piece of wood, or wooden implement, with which the [fire in the kind of oven called] تَنُّور is stirred: pl. مَفَائِدُ. (S, L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
